steps.title: Remove Wheels
steps.text: Remove the wheels from your vehicle to access the calipers.

steps.title: Fitment Check
steps.text: Ensure that the caliper covers align perfectly with your vehicle's calipers for a professional finish.

steps.title: Clean Calipers
steps.text: Thoroughly clean the brake calipers with isopropyl alcohol to create a pristine surface for adhesive application.

steps.title: Prepare Glue
steps.text: Identify the areas on the caliper where the glue will be applied and prepare the adhesive accordingly.

steps.title: Apply Adhesive
steps.text: Apply the glue to the designated areas on the brake caliper, ensuring sufficient coverage to fill gaps between the caliper covers and the brake calipers.

steps.title: Secure Cover
steps.text: Align the cover carefully and apply firm hand pressure to ensure it is securely attached.

steps.title: Final Cleaning
steps.text: Gently clean the caliper cover with a microfiber cloth for a polished finish.

steps.title: Repeat Steps for Rear Calipers
steps.text: Repeat the same steps for the rear calipers, ensuring precise installation for a consistent look.

steps.title: Allow Drying Time
steps.text: Give the adhesive at least 2 hours to dry fully before driving.

steps.title: Enjoy Your Enhanced Vehicle
steps.text: Your vehicle is now equipped with sleek, modern caliper covers. Drive safe and in style!
